text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
NameAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
PlaceIn(x, y) ::: x is a place located in y.
PartOf(x, y) ::: x is considered part of y.
Premises:
BarutinCove is named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin ::: NameAfter(BarutinCove, Barutin).
BarutinCove is on the southwest coast of SnowIsland ::: LocatedIn(BarutinCove, SnowIsland).
SnowIsland, GreenwichIsland, and DeceptionIsland are part of the SouthShetlandIslands ::: PartOf(SnowIsland, SouthShetlandIslands) ∧ PartOf(GreenwichIsland, SouthShetlandIslands) ∧ PartOf(DeceptionIsland, SouthShetlandIslands).
SouthShetlandIslands are part of Antarctica ::: PartOf(SouthShetlandIslands, Antarctica).
If A is located in B and B is located in C, then A is located in C ::: ∀x ∀y ∀z ((LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ LocatedIn(y, z)) → LocatedIn(x, z))
Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (NameAfter(x, y) ∧ PlaceIn(y, Antarctica)) ::: There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria
